mapper.select: SELECT nickname, brand_name_zh, brand_name_en, slogan, weekly_target_count, weekly_completed_count, latest_score, latest_report_id, has_avatar FROM v_user_dashboard WHERE user_id = #{userId}

SELECT t.topic_id AS id, c.category_name AS category, t.title, t.difficulty, t.duration_min, t.duration_max, t.guide_text AS guide, 0 AS favorite FROM topics t INNER JOIN categories c ON c.category_id = t.category_id WHERE t.is_recommended = 1 ORDER BY t.sort_order LIMIT 1

SELECT r.total_score FROM training_sessions s INNER JOIN analysis_reports r ON r.session_id = s.session_id WHERE s.user_id = #{userId} AND s.status = 'completed' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM privacy_settings p WHERE p.user_id = s.user_id AND p.keep_training_history = 1 ) ORDER BY s.ended_at DESC, s.session_id DESC LIMIT 1 OFFSET 1

SELECT r.report_id AS id, t.topic_id, t.title, s.ended_at, s.duration_seconds, r.total_score AS score, r.speech_rate, r.pause_count, r.fluency_score AS fluency, r.result_label AS label, r.transcript, r.content_score, r.content_summary, CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM session_audios a WHERE a.session_id = s.session_id) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS has_audio FROM analysis_reports r INNER JOIN training_sessions s ON s.session_id = r.session_id INNER JOIN topics t ON t.topic_id = s.topic_id WHERE r.report_id = #{reportId} AND s.user_id = #{userId}
SELECT feedback_type, content FROM report_feedbacks WHERE report_id = #{reportId} ORDER BY sort_order

SELECT r.report_id, s.session_id, s.topic_id, t.title AS topic_title, COALESCE(s.ended_at, s.started_at, s.created_at) AS trained_at, s.duration_seconds, r.total_score, s.status, s.fail_reason FROM training_sessions s INNER JOIN topics t ON t.topic_id = s.topic_id LEFT JOIN analysis_reports r ON r.session_id = s.session_id WHERE s.user_id = #{userId} AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM privacy_settings p WHERE p.user_id = s.user_id AND p.keep_training_history = 1 ) ORDER BY trained_at DESC, s.session_id DESC
SELECT brand_name_zh, brand_name_en, slogan, about_text, version_name, as_of_date FROM app_meta WHERE meta_id = 1
SELECT title, content FROM help_articles ORDER BY sort_order

SELECT r.total_score, r.speech_rate, r.pause_count, r.fluency_score, r.result_label FROM training_sessions s INNER JOIN analysis_reports r ON r.session_id = s.session_id WHERE s.user_id = #{userId} AND s.topic_id = #{topicId} AND s.status = 'completed' ORDER BY s.ended_at DESC, s.session_id DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT ended_at FROM training_sessions WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND ended_at IS NOT NULL ORDER BY ended_at DESC, session_id DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO report_feedbacks (report_id, feedback_type, content, sort_order) VALUES (#{reportId}, #{feedbackType}, #{content}, #{sortOrder})
INSERT INTO session_audios (session_id, mime_type, byte_size, audio_data) VALUES (#{sessionId}, #{mimeType}, #{byteSize}, #{audioData,jdbcType=BLOB})
mapper.select: SELECT s.session_id, s.topic_id, s.status, s.duration_seconds, s.fail_reason, CASE WHEN a.session_id IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END AS has_audio FROM training_sessions s LEFT JOIN session_audios a ON a.session_id = s.session_id WHERE s.user_id = #{userId} AND s.topic_id = #{topicId} AND s.status IN ('recording', 'paused', 'analyzing', 'failed') ORDER BY s.session_id DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT s.session_id, s.topic_id, s.status, s.duration_seconds, s.fail_reason, CASE WHEN a.session_id IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END AS has_audio FROM training_sessions s LEFT JOIN session_audios a ON a.session_id = s.session_id WHERE s.user_id = #{userId} AND s.session_id = #{sessionId}
mapper.update: UPDATE training_sessions SET status = #{status}, fail_reason = #{failReason}, ended_at = COALESCE(#{endedAt}, ended_at), duration_seconds = COALESCE(#{durationSeconds}, duration_seconds) WHERE session_id = #{sessionId} AND user_id = #{userId} AND FIND_IN_SET(status, #{allowed})
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO session_audios (session_id, mime_type, byte_size, audio_data) VALUES (#{sessionId}, #{mimeType}, #{byteSize}, #{audioData,jdbcType=BLOB}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE mime_type = VALUES(mime_type), byte_size = VALUES(byte_size), audio_data = VALUES(audio_data)
mapper.select: SELECT label, keywords FROM topic_checkpoints WHERE topic_id = #{topicId} ORDER BY sort_order, checkpoint_id
